deep_dive.case_for: It is a grade A business. Revenue grew 83.38% over the last year, and its price-to-sales ratio is near the bottom of its own 5-year history. At $149.30 it sits below its whole value range ($194.80–$411.04), and next-year earnings estimates rose 4.34% in 30 days.
deep_dive.case_against: The stock fell 30.68% in 20 sessions and is still making lower highs and lower lows. Operating margin is at a 5-year peak of 65%, and those peaks usually fade. Unpaid customer bills rose 127% against sales up 106%, insiders sold $946.6M outside pre-set plans, and the headlines mention a Huang scandal and a missed SEC filing.
deep_dive.decides: For the long term, it comes down to whether the high margins hold. For a swing trade, it comes down to a daily close above $171.33. Until then, any long-term buy should go in small steps, because the nearest support is far below at $122.83–$126.17.
